# Holiday Hiring Push 2026

- **Goal / definition of done:** hire and onboard **~18 seasonal associates** (front-end, sales floor,
  stockroom) so the store is fully staffed **before Black Friday (2026-11-27)**; target all offers out by
  early November, onboarding/Trailhead certs done by mid-November.
- **Owner:** [Tanya Brooks](../people/tanya-brooks.md) (AM, Sales & Service), with
  [Angela Foster](../people/angela-foster.md) (HR) on reqs, offers, and I-9/onboarding compliance.
- **Status:** **kicked off 2026-07-24**, ramping. Job reqs posting this week; first hiring event planned for August.
- **Open items:**
  - Finalize seasonal **headcount** with Angela (commitment due 2026-08-01).
  - Schedule two in-store hiring events (August + September).
  - Decide how many seasonals convert to permanent after the season.
- **Risks:** tight local labor market; the open **AM backfill** ([Kyle Bennett](../people/kyle-bennett.md)'s
  role) is competing for HR's attention at the same time.
